label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.18… supports Whatever is in potency in no respect…
note: The claim gives God the highest life because his nature is his own understanding; ad 2 adds that God is his own esse, understanding and living. The encoded bridge generalizes from God to whatever is in potency in no respect and keeps only that such a thing has some immanent operation; the step from pure act to understanding is not stated in the article.
